partner_context.their_ambition: Hong Kong operates one of the world's busiest and most storied passenger ferry systems — the Star Ferry across Victoria Harbour, the outlying-island routes to Lamma, Cheung Chau and Mui Wo, and the high-speed cross-boundary crossings to Macau and the Pearl River Delta.
partner_context.their_pressure: The fleet is ageing and diesel-powered, under a government mandate to decarbonize harbour and ferry transport. The Macau and PRD crossings face intense competition from the Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macau Bridge, and operators need a faster, cleaner, more modern passenger experience to defend the sea route.
partner_context.where_navier_fits: Foiling-electric vessels modernize the fleet on every front at once: zero-emission for the harbour decarbonization mandate, faster and far smoother for the Macau/PRD crossings, and software-defined for an operating cost curve that keeps improving — the clean fleet-modernization narrative for the world's busiest ferry waters.

hero.title: Navier × Hong Kong — the harbour and the crossing, re-platformed
hero.subtitle: From the Star Ferry to the Macau run — foiling-electric across the world's busiest ferry waters.
hero.what_we_do_together: We modernize Hong Kong's passenger marine network with foiling-electric vessels — across Victoria Harbour, out to the outlying islands, and on the high-speed crossings to Macau and the Pearl River Delta. Navier supplies the software-defined fleet, captain training and certification path; the operator brings the routes, terminals, licences and the world's deepest ferry-passenger base. Together we turn an ageing diesel fleet into the cleanest, fastest, smoothest crossing in the region.

why_now: Hong Kong has a stated harbour and ferry decarbonization mandate, with diesel ferry fleets facing replacement. The Macau and PRD sea crossings — among the busiest in the world — are under competitive pressure from the HZMB bridge and need a step-change to defend ridership. The Greater Bay Area integration agenda is pushing more cross-boundary passenger volume onto every available mode. Foiling-electric answers all three at once, exactly as the fleet-replacement cycle arrives.
multimodal_fit: Foiling vessels run from the existing Star Ferry piers, the outlying-island terminals and the Macau/China Ferry terminals — integrating with the MTR and the cross-boundary network. The water leg becomes the fast, clean spine connecting Hong Kong Island, Kowloon, the islands, the airport's SkyPier and the PRD mainland.

proof_points.claim: These are the world's busiest ferry waters.
proof_points.evidence: Victoria Harbour, the outlying-island network and the HK↔Macau crossing carry tens of millions of passenger trips a year.
Hong Kong has a stated harbour and ferry decarbonization agenda with diesel fleets due for replacement.

proof_points.claim: The crossing needs to defend itself.
proof_points.evidence: The HZMB bridge has drawn volume off the sea route; a faster, cleaner crossing is the defensible response.

proof_points.claim: The network model is proven and at scale.
proof_points.evidence: ~100 vessels / $100M phased rollout already underway in the Maldives.

objections.concern: Can it handle Pearl River estuary conditions and busy shipping lanes?
objections.response: Foiling delivers a smoother ride than displacement ferries in estuary chop; Quanta-LR hybrid covers the full crossing with no charging infrastructure, and software-defined controls suit dense, regulated traffic lanes.

objections.concern: Passenger capacity vs. large diesel ferries?
objections.response: Navier's model is higher-frequency, faster turnarounds and a premium tier rather than a single large hull — defending ridership on experience and speed; the fleet scales with demand.

objections.concern: Charging at terminals across two jurisdictions?
objections.response: Pioneer II needs only a berth pedestal on the harbour and island routes; Quanta-LR needs no charging at all for the Macau/PRD crossings — removing the cross-boundary infrastructure problem.

objections.concern: Certification across HK / Macau / mainland waters?
objections.response: A clear first-of-class path with software-defined controls and an operating record in the US and the Maldives to anchor the regional certification case.

phases.label: Phase 1 — Victoria Harbour modernization
phases.narrative: Launch foiling-electric vessels on the Star Ferry and inner-harbour routes — the most visible, highest-frequency, decarbonization-mandated waters in the city.
phases.rationale: Start on the iconic harbour where the decarbonization mandate is loudest and visibility is highest.

phases.label: Phase 2 — outlying islands
phases.narrative: Extend to Lamma, Cheung Chau, Mui Wo and Discovery Bay — the commuter and leisure outlying-island network — with faster, silent, frequent foiling links.
phases.rationale: Bring the islands network onto the platform where speed and frequency transform the commute.

phases.label: Phase 3 — Macau & PRD crossings
phases.narrative: Deploy Quanta-LR on the high-speed crossings to Macau and the Pearl River Delta — the competitive, high-value cross-boundary routes that defend the sea route against the bridge.
phases.rationale: Capture the marquee cross-boundary crossings once the harbour and island network is proven.

the_ask.partner_brings: The ferry routes, terminals, licences, cross-boundary relationships and the world's deepest ferry-passenger base.

close.title: The world's busiest ferry waters, re-platformed.
close.body: From the Star Ferry to the Macau run, Hong Kong's marine network is due for renewal. Foiling-electric decarbonizes the harbour and defends the crossing in one move — the cleanest, fastest, smoothest passage in the Greater Bay Area.

why_navier_now.step_change: Hydrofoiling lifts the hull clear of the water, so a Navier vessel flies instead of plowing through chop - roughly 10x more efficient than a conventional planing boat, faster (30+ kt cruise), and dramatically smoother and quieter. It's software-defined and autonomy-ready, so the same fleet keeps getting better and cheaper to run over time.
why_navier_now.no_new_infrastructure: Navier rides on infrastructure that already exists - the open ocean and the piers and ferry terminals already in use. No vertiports, no new rights-of-way. Pioneer II needs only a berth pedestal; the Quanta-LR hybrid needs no charging infrastructure at all.
why_navier_now.the_moment: Three forces just converged: the technology crossed from prototype to platform (10 vessels delivered, 4,000+ flight hours, 2025 production sold out), decarbonization mandates turned legacy diesel ferry fleets into stranded liabilities, and the hybrid removed the range excuse. The marine layer is being claimed cluster-by-cluster right now.

steady_state.tam_framing: Tens of millions of ferry passenger trips a year across the world's busiest passenger-ferry waters.

end_state.narrative: Steady state is a fully modernized Hong Kong marine network: a silent foiling Star Ferry, fast island links, and a defended Macau/PRD crossing — the clean spine of Greater Bay Area passenger water transport.
